title: 第841章 古尘中计第840章 古尘追击
lines: 一名千夫长刚举起灵盾。
骨矛直接贯穿他的胸膛，将他钉死在山壁之上！
数十头巨型魔兽同时扑入军阵。
那些魔兽浑身覆盖黑甲。
口中不断喷吐腐蚀魔炎。
大片天罡兵被魔炎吞没。
一头魔兽当场被斩成两半！
三名魔兵已经同时扑来！
魔刀、魔枪、骨刺同时轰落！
耿琥怒吼，周身雷霆炸裂！
数十名魔兵被当场炸碎！
天尊古尘出手了，一步踏出，天地骤静。
无尽灵光，于他身后疯狂汇聚！
一尊万丈法相，缓缓浮现！
恐怖威压，瞬间覆盖整座峡谷！
大量魔兵甚至被直接压跪！
古尘双眸冰冷，一步踏空，根本不把这三个古魔放在眼里。
content_en:
A captain just raised his spiritual shield.
The next moment.
The bone spear penetrated directly through his chest and nailed him to the mountain wall!
other side.
Dozens of giant monsters rushed into the military formation at the same time.
Those monsters were covered in black armor.
Corrosive demonic flames are constantly spitting out from his mouth.
A large number of Tiangang soldiers were swallowed up by the demonic flames.
The body rots rapidly!
"Stabilize the formation!!!"
"Don't mess!!!"
General Geng Hu roared and brandished his sword.
The sword light swept across!
boom! ! !
A monster was cut in half on the spot!
But the next moment.
Three magic soldiers have rushed at the same time!
The magic knife, magic spear, and bone spurs were blasted down at the same time!
"Go away!!!"
Geng Hu roared, and thunder exploded around him!
"Thunder Prison Demon Seal!!!"
Boom!
A large area of ​​lightning spreads!
Dozens of demon soldiers were blown to pieces on the spot!
But the battlefield is too big.
There is no way to kill them all!
And at this time.
Tianzun Guchen took action, taking one step and the world suddenly became silent.
The next moment.
Endless spiritual light gathered crazily behind him!
A ten-thousand-foot-long Dharma image slowly emerged!
The appearance of the Dharma is like an ancient immortal.
Wearing a golden robe.
Stepping on the stars.
Nine rounds of blazing sun are suspended behind him.
The terrifying pressure instantly covers the entire canyon!
A large number of demon soldiers were even directly suppressed to their knees!
"Tianzun Dharma..."
"Gu Chen is serious!"
Many Tiangang soldiers looked excited.
Gu Chen's eyes were cold and he took one step in vain. He didn't take these three ancient demons seriously at all.
"Tiangang Shenxiao Jue——"
Boom! ! !
Thousands of spiritual lights burst out at the same time!
title_en: Chapter 841 Gu Chen falls into the trap Chapter 840 Gu Chen pursues
